description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing 'Capabilities' data in the database using Room, an Android persistence library. It includes methods for inserting capabilities and retrieving them by a specific ID.

classes.name: CapabilitiesDao
classes.description: An interface defining database operations related to 'Capabilities' entities, annotated for Room database processing.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a Capabilities object into the database, replacing any existing record with a conflict.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the Capabilities object with ID 1 from the database.
